statement: ∀ n : ℕ, let R := (Finset.Icc 2 n).filter Nat.Prime; let D := (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ (R.filter (fun r => ((Finset.Ioc r (n/r)).filter (fun v => v.Prime ∧ p+r*v=n)).Nonempty)).Nonempty); let B := D.filter (fun p => (R.filter (fun r => r ∣ n ∧ ((Finset.Ioc r (n/r)).filter (fun v => v.Prime ∧ p+r*v=n)).Nonempty)).Nonempty); let L := R.filter (fun r => ¬ r∣n ∧ r^3≤n); let H := R.filter (fun r => ¬ r∣n ∧ n<r^3); let F := fun r : ℕ => ((Finset.Ioc r (n/r)).filter (fun v => v.Prime ∧ (n-r*v).Prime)).card; D.card = B.card + (∑ r ∈ L, F r) + (∑ r ∈ H, F r) ∧ B.card≤n.primeFactors.card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9020 · 按较小因子的立方切分陈氏不同因子余项并界定坏模数
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9020 · Split distinct-factor Chen remainders at the cube-root threshold and bound the bad moduli

brief.zh: 不同素因子按 r<v 唯一排序。r∣n 时 p 必须等于 r，所以坏模数合计至多为 n 的不同素因子个数。两个好模数和都保留 n−rv 的素性。
brief.en: Order the distinct primes uniquely by r<v. If r divides n, primality forces p=r, so the total bad contribution is at most the number of distinct prime factors of n. Both good-modulus sums retain primality of n−rv.
